cases.scope: Export individual course attendance sheets as named PDFs.
cases.problem: In March a training coordinator said the portal exported one combined PDF and they spent 40 minutes splitting it.
cases.followup: In November the same coordinator wrote: The new individual export names every file from the roster. I tested all 60 sheets and it works; I no longer split them.
cases.label: RESOLVED

cases.scope: Match returned library items to the original loan records.
cases.problem: A librarian still manually matches returns every Friday because the matching dashboard drops loan IDs.
cases.followup: The dashboard vendor documents a barcode matching feature. Last Friday the librarian tested that feature and 19 of 80 records still had missing loan IDs.
cases.label: PERSISTING

cases.scope: Keep a volunteer rota synchronized across two calendars.
cases.problem: A volunteer coordinator reported that recurring assignments disagree between two calendars.
cases.followup: A scheduling provider offers email reminders. No evidence addresses calendar synchronization or whether the coordinator tried it.
cases.label: UNKNOWN

cases.scope: Convert a supplier spreadsheet into a daily inventory reconciliation.
cases.problem: A shop clerk wants inventory movements in a single daily report.
cases.followup: Another retailer paid $80 to design an attractive printed product catalog; its designer reported no catalog issues.
cases.label: ADJACENT

cases.scope: Flag missing fields in monthly maintenance checklists.
cases.problem: An office manager needs missing serial numbers flagged before filing each monthly inspection sheet.
cases.followup: I paid $49 for ChecklistPro last month specifically for missing-field validation. Even with its validation enabled, blank serials pass every month and I still check by hand.
cases.label: PAID_PERSISTING

cases.scope: Generate a newsletter draft with accurate citations from supplied notes.
cases.problem: An editor spent an hour each week correcting broken references in generated drafts.
cases.followup: The editor says: I switched on citation verification on Tuesday and all four subsequent drafts used the correct references. That correction step is gone.
cases.label: RESOLVED

cases.scope: Combine weekly sports club registration files into one deduplicated roster.
cases.problem: Every week the administrator merges two registrations and removes duplicate member IDs manually.
cases.followup: The administrator tried the advertised deduplication option yesterday; it deleted valid sibling records, so we still spend half an hour reviewing each batch.
cases.label: PERSISTING

cases.scope: Check web form submission totals against a downloaded report.
cases.problem: A buyer requests this reconciliation and posts a budget of $120.
cases.followup: The listing says awarded. It does not say the work was completed, the buyer paid, or that current tools were attempted.
cases.label: UNKNOWN

cases.scope: Create searchable text from scanned invoices without changing original amounts.
cases.problem: A purchaser struggles to transcribe text from scanned invoices.
cases.followup: A user of the same platform complains that their invoices are difficult to design because its logo editor has few fonts.
cases.label: ADJACENT

cases.scope: Prepare a recurring caption file with matching timestamps.
cases.problem: A media editor says their weekly transcript timestamps drift after export.
cases.followup: The editor reports: I subscribed for $30 per month to the timing correction extension and paid the latest invoice. The timestamps still drift on every export, requiring an hour of correction.
cases.label: PAID_PERSISTING

cases.scope: Produce individual route manifests with correct vehicle IDs.
cases.problem: A dispatcher manually renamed each manifest because the previous system used sequential numbers.
cases.followup: The dispatcher confirms after upgrading: Every exported manifest now carries its vehicle ID, and today's 35-file run required no renaming.
cases.label: RESOLVED

cases.scope: Send a private project status report without including completed work.
cases.problem: A project lead must manually delete completed tickets every week before sharing the report.
cases.followup: The product has a status filter. The lead says the filter works in the preview but completed tickets reappear in each weekly exported PDF; manual cleanup remains.
cases.label: PERSISTING

cases.scope: Check extracted meeting decisions against an approved transcript.
cases.problem: A consultant says AI notes were inaccurate in a post two years ago.
cases.followup: Current documentation says users can inspect the source transcript and edit notes. No recent observation establishes accuracy or outcome for that consultant.
cases.label: UNKNOWN

cases.scope: Find duplicate orders before importing an order spreadsheet.
cases.problem: A seller wants duplicate order references flagged at import.
cases.followup: The complaint supplied concerns duplicate promotional emails sent to customers, not duplicate order records.
cases.label: ADJACENT

cases.scope: Export a monthly expense table without dropping rows.
cases.problem: A community association treasurer still checks every monthly export for missing rows.
cases.followup: Our association paid $75 last month for the premium complete-export module. The new export still omits transactions with blank categories, so I redo the export manually every month.
cases.label: PAID_PERSISTING

cases.scope: Create booking confirmations in two languages from a roster.
cases.problem: A coordinator formerly copied confirmations into two templates manually.
cases.followup: The coordinator says today's new language-aware template produced both versions for every booking. We tested ten cases and removed the manual step.
cases.label: RESOLVED

cases.scope: Retain previous monthly non-sensitive equipment counts when refreshing a dashboard.
cases.problem: The operations analyst loses prior counts each month after replacing the input file.
cases.followup: The vendor offers historical snapshots. The analyst says they enabled snapshots last month and the latest refresh still overwrote the prior counts. They would pay for a reliable fix, but no payment occurred.
cases.label: PERSISTING

cases.scope: Verify that each generated PDF corresponds to the source record.
cases.problem: An administrator would like an automatic check but has not tried any generator yet.
cases.followup: A vendor offers a verification feature and has posted pricing. No observed mismatch, attempted use, or payment is described.
cases.label: UNKNOWN

cases.scope: Generate a downloadable weekly staff availability spreadsheet.
cases.problem: A manager wants to export staff availability on Fridays.
cases.followup: An employee complains that the scheduling app's mobile push notification sometimes arrives late. No export problem is described.
cases.label: ADJACENT

cases.scope: Check that each item in a recurring public event list has a working registration URL.
cases.problem: A community organizer finds broken registration URLs each week.
cases.followup: I paid a freelancer $60 to configure our link checker last month. It still marks expired registration pages as valid, and I have needed to test all links manually for the last three weeks.
